messages:
lee: Noticing a spike in tiny-gpu Pending in ap-southeast1, but nodes report free GPU. Logs show repeated attach/detach on the same warmpool hosts. Anyone else seeing controller flaps?

olivia: Yep. gce attach controller logs show `AttachVolume timeout` around 03:12 and 03:18, then kubelet flips NodeReady.

nina: Net metrics show retransmit rate up between 03:10-03:20 for 1a/1c. Traceroute shows path asymmetry. Could be intermittent interconnect.

lee: That explains why scheduler binds then pods get evicted — tiny slots scatter across AZs and end up fragmented.

kai: Quick mitigations: 1) label problematic warmpool nodes with `warmpool-frag=avoid` so scheduler steers away; 2) lower scheduler bind concurrency for tiny-gpu; 3) scale warmpool +2 to absorb drains.

olivia: Also recommend bumping attach timeout for the controller as a short-term fix to avoid false detach. Filed infra ticket INF-4080 for controller timeout tuning.

lee: commands: `kubectl label nodes node-abc warmpool-frag=avoid --overwrite` and `kubectl scale deployment/warmpool-ap-southeast1 --replicas=14 -n infra`.

infra-bot: [autoscaler] warmpool-ap-southeast1 target increased from 12 -> 14 (requested by @lee).

nina: I'll open a provider ticket for the interconnect asymmetry and attach traces: CLOUD-10012. Also will lower warmpool attach failure alert from 10m->2m for faster detection.

kai: If this stabilizes, we should add scheduler logic: per-pod bind backoff when repeated bind->fail cycles occur, and prefer same-AZ rebinds. I'll draft an RFC.

lee: Update 03:22: after scaling and bind throttle, Pending tiny-gpu reduced ~50%, attach flaps decreased. Leaving labels for 30m, then revert.

olivia: Good. Keep monitoring attach/detach and preemptions for 45m.

nina: Noted. Will paste provider ticket once created.

lee: Thanks folks. Keeping this thread open until provider confirms root cause.
